redstonevisualizer.config.title: Redstone Visualizer
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.baseOp: Opacity from 0 to 100 percent for inactive blocks.
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.durati: Total visibility duration in game ticks.
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.fadeTi: Fade duration in game ticks; it cannot exceed the total duration.
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.alertT: Show an alert above this many positions; it does not block activation.
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.whitel: Namespaced block identifiers that stay fully visible.
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.toggle: Keybind used to toggle the visualizer.
redstonevisualizer.config.comment.openMe: Keybind used to open the visualizer settings.
